svg.title: MomentLens notional architecture
svg.desc: Users reach an Azure App Service web app. Videos are stored in Azure Storage behind private endpoints and analysed by Azure AI Video Indexer, with a Container Apps job collecting the insights. Azure OpenAI enriches and embeds the scenes, and Azure AI Search serves hybrid, semantic and vector queries. A managed identity, a virtual network, a container registry and Azure Monitor support every component.
svg.text: Natural-language search for the right moment in a video, built on Azure AI services
Platform services used by every component
